howto.what: 当用户询问 git、curl 等命令的手册内容时,Claude 会根据内置的 man page 资料,提供语法结构、选项说明、示例用法,并可通过 SEE ALSO 关联到相关命令。
howto.when: 当用户测试 man golden build,或要求查看 git、curl 等命令的语法、选项、示例时触发。

say.text: git log 命令有哪些常用选项？
say.note: 会从 man page 资料中返回选项列表和说明。
会查 curl 的 man page 并解释该参数。

say.text: git-diff 与 git-log 有什么关系？
say.note: 会通过 SEE ALSO 关联介绍相关命令。

howto.what_en: When asked about manual pages of commands like git or curl, Claude uses the built-in man page references to provide syntax, option explanations, examples, and related commands via SEE ALSO.
howto.when_en: Triggered when testing the man golden build, or when the user asks for syntax, options, or examples of commands like git and curl.

say_en.text: What are the common options for git log?
say_en.note: Returns options and explanations from the man page reference.

say_en.text: What does the curl -s flag mean?
say_en.note: Looks up curl's man page and explains the flag.

say_en.text: How are git-diff and git-log related?
say_en.note: Uses SEE ALSO to introduce related commands.
